title: Install and operate EMT
summary: Install matched EMT program and provider bytes, configure paused state, and operate its worker and owned maintenance without silently approving a failure halt.
use_when: The current user must install matched EMT bytes, configure or activate its worker, inspect readiness, take a drained backup, or recover a coordinated update.
do_not_use_when: The user needs another recipient, sender authentication, continuous repair, or a replacement for product-owned recovery.
outcome: An explicitly configured or maintained EMT installation with separate schedule, pause and failure-halt state.
effects: Agent work can inspect and operate current-user Cell systems and send incident email under the authorized exchange. Configuration, scheduling, maintenance and installation have their documented separate effects.

Coordinated setup resolves missing receiving settings through Email before maintenance, initializes state if absent, records a durable migration receipt, prepares a disabled exact definition, and activates after every hold is released. It preserves original absence, disabled intent, operator pause and failure halts unless a supported setup option changes operator intent.
authority: EMT owns its configuration, admission, state, maintenance holds and installation. Clockwork owns scheduling and exact failure-halt continuation; Nucleus owns jobs; Email owns transport and credentials.
success: Verify matching program/provider, valid configuration and schema, known maintenance counts and preserved or explicitly requested schedule, pause and exact halt intent. Interpret Email acceptance and product success separately.
failure_and_recovery: Stop on missing authority or dependencies, unknown drain, failed backup verification, unestablished hold ownership or initialized direct selector recovery. Use maintained coordinator recovery with the original receipt, backup and captured intent; preserve uncertain exchanges and mail identities.
privacy: Correspondence and pointers remain private and retained. Nucleus and email providers keep separate copies. Logs and ordinary status omit bodies.
does_not_authorize: Unrequested recipients, unrelated mutations, automatic failed-job replacement, or clearing a newer Clockwork halt.

consumers.statement: The current user and authorized EMT installation, activation or maintenance operator.

preconditions.statement: The chosen installation or operational effect is authorized, dependencies and receiving domain are established, initialized maintenance configuration is valid, and any changed configuration is paused and drained.
New preparation requires initialized Bazaar state and a complete cell.prompts.emt selection; seed import and historical version preservation precede deployment, which supplies no missing content.

inputs.statement: Matched absolute program/provider paths, selected current configuration, explicit schedule and pause intent, exact maintenance owner, and a separate absolute private backup destination.

outputs.statement: Program/provider selection, configuration, doctor and schedule observations, known drain status, migration backup/receipt evidence and preserved or explicitly selected activation intent.

data_semantics.statement: Installation, initialization, configuration, admission and scheduling are separate effects. Counts describe retained records. Unknown outstanding counts cannot satisfy drain; installation or resume does not approve an exact Clockwork halt.

identity_and_units.statement: emt/worker selects the exact Clockwork binding; OWNER identifies the operation hold; INCIDENT_ID selects exact halt continuation; backup digests and the migration receipt preserve recovery identity.

completeness_and_freshness.statement: Verification reads selected local installation, configuration, doctor, schedule and maintenance observations at their boundaries; receiving permission and final delivery remain not_probed by doctor.
No timer latency, model accuracy, final-delivery deadline, future support lifetime or retention horizon is promised.

access.statement: Procedures operate current-user private state. Activation requires account-read, investigation and mail authority, with unrestricted current-user agent execution and deferred sender verification. Explicit reads and backups can expose correspondence.

lifecycle_and_consistency.statement: Prepare dependencies and refresh compatible Clockwork brokers before routing. Coordinated initialized updates capture intent, hold/drain, preserve migration evidence, install matched bytes, select a disabled exact definition and restore captured intent only after verification.

Fresh valid deployment activates after verification unless explicit paused/enabled settings override. An existing absent binding stays absent unless activation is explicitly requested. Recovery reuses original backup and captured intent; direct initialized selector recovery is unsupported.

operational_limits.statement: Only schema-one migration is supported. Configuration changes require paused drained work; backups do not overwrite unmatched destinations or restore provider histories. Required features retain worker, assignment and transport bounds.

compatibility_and_evolution.statement: The procedure retains its stable operation identity and version while required feature contracts provide detailed compatible behavior. Matched program, installer and bundle travel with the release.
No future support lifetime or retention horizon is promised.

reliances.statement: Incident authority, deadlines, exact identities and recovery are owned by the EMT incident feature.
EMT service state, readiness, maintenance, matched installation and recovery are owned by the service feature.
Quota deferral and frozen notice delivery preserve their independent recovery rules.
Receiving domain discovery uses the supported Email account-settings interface.
Prompt readiness depends on exact published Bazaar text versions; EMT owns the complete selection content.

steps: Establish authority, dependencies, prompt selection, receiving domain and stable paths before maintenance or activation.
Install matched bytes before initialization, or use maintained coordinated deployment for initialized updates.
Initialize paused state, configure drained work, inspect doctor, then resume and enable only authorized intent.
Inspect separate pause, schedule, holds and exact halt evidence; approve exact failure-halt continuation separately.
Hold with an exact owner, drain known work, back up private state and preserve original migration evidence before release.
Verify matched publication and preserved or explicitly requested operator intent; retain unresolved holds on recovery failure.
checkpoints: The selected EMT binary and provider versions match.
Configuration, operator pause, schedule enablement and failure halts remain separate.
Drained backups preserve correspondence and Nucleus references.
adaptation: Install missing compatible dependencies before enabling EMT.
Preserve existing pauses, disabled bindings and other maintenance owners.
stop_when: Ownership, drained state, backup compatibility or dependency readiness cannot be established.
An initialized update attempts direct selector recovery.
